name: R3-Y2
description: R3-Y2 was an R3-series astromech droid that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was stationed in the command center of Echo Base, the Alliance's headquarters on the planet Hoth. After the base was discovered by the Galactic Empire, R3-Y2 helped to evacuate the rebel forces stationed there during the Battle of Hoth.
